HPAC-PAWA-001 S33C TrustedProtectedAuthorityConsumer remains the sole production protected-consumer admission model, unweakened by either companion contract. presentation_evidence_write has exactly one production owner -- the verified protected presentation helper -- across all three documents (HPAC-PAWA-HELPER-REQ-070; HPAC-PPA-REQ-077/-081), superseding HPAC-PPA-REQ-054 and the launcher-holder clause of HPAC-PPA-REQ-041 by name. No authority object or semantic equivalent (HPACWriterCapability / HPACStoreAuthority / handle / seal / reconstructable descriptor) crosses the ordinary-process<->PAWA-helper boundary or the launcher<->presentation-helper boundary (PAWA-INV-15/-16; HPAC-PPA-REQ-078/-087/-099, PPA-INV-9). Human election, presentation evidence, authentication proof, and Gate5/PB/runtime/effect remain pairwise distinct across the trio (HPAC-PPA-REQ-093..095). Replay/currentness, no-auto-retry, and the composed state-transition model agree across HPAC-PAWA-HELPER-001 S18-S23 and HPAC-PPA-001 S21 REQ-090..092. HPAC-PRESENTATION-EVIDENCE/2.0 requires NO SCHEMA CHANGE, independently re-confirmed against the actual TrustedApprovalPresentationEvidence schema source (src/pcae/core/approval_presentation.py, 13 fields, none encoding producer-process location). No new pawa_failure_code or RHAMP terminal_reason_code required. Mechanism neutrality, deterministic-vs-real, and bounded security-claim boundaries preserved. Sibling contracts (HPAC-001 v2.1, RHAMP-001 v1.0, HBDC-001 v1.2, RIHAC-001 v2.0, RIASC-001 v3.0, RDGO-001 v3.1) confirmed byte-unchanged and semantically unwidened. Runtime Observed / observe / unavailable; 0 plugins / 0 capabilities; first governed runtime external effect ABSENT / UNREACHABLE. Trust-boundary contract set now READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION.
